description: Named TS/Rust output differences accepted because Rust is intentionally better or TS cannot express the value. Each entry names the exact venue, tape SHA and diagnostic paths, its category, rationale and evidence. An accepted key that is no longer reproduced fails verification. Accepted differences are not known failures: they never cover performance, coverage or harness integrity diagnostics.

diagnostics.rationale: K2: Kraken open_orders qty is the unfilled size, so the total is qty plus filled. TS shows qty as the total and subtracts filled again; Rust shows the true total and remainder.
diagnostics.evidence: sdk-rs/harness/tapes/kraken-private.jsonl open_orders row with qty 2 and filled 0.5; venues/kraken/tests pin the rule (#2726).

diagnostics.rationale: K7: Rust moves a stop with the native editorder and keeps its id; TS cancels and replaces it under a new id, leaving a moment with no stop.
diagnostics.evidence: sdk-rs/harness/private-tape-kraken.mjs amendOrder 202, tagged impl rust and ts (#2742).

diagnostics.rationale: Rust reads the minimum from tradeMinQuantity. TS reads tradeMinLimit, which BingX reports as 0 on every contract, so TS shows no minimum.
diagnostics.evidence: sdk-rs/harness/fixtures/bingx-public.jsonl.gz /quote/contracts: 0G-USDT has tradeMinQuantity 8.807 and tradeMinLimit 0; tradeMinLimit is 0 on all rows.

diagnostics.rationale: BloFin REST balance is the wallet: it holds position margin and leaves out unrealized PnL. TS adds available and frozen, low by the margin with a position open, and subtracts PnL again.
diagnostics.evidence: Live /api/v1/asset/balances with a position open: balance 68.3127, available 67.8972, initial margin 0.4155 (deaws2); venues/blofin/tests/account.rs.

diagnostics.rationale: min_notional is dollars, not a size. TS publishes it as the minimum amount, so SOL shows a minimum of 10 contracts, about 940 dollars, and an order defaulting to the minimum sends that.
diagnostics.evidence: Live SOL market row from deaws2; venues/paradex/tests/public.rs.
